news.headline: Two Lion Cubs Are Born in Scotland
news.body: Edinburgh Zoo in Scotland has two brand-new Asiatic lion cubs, its first lion cubs in seven years! Their mom, Bindee, gave birth on October 11, and keepers watched it all on cameras inside her cozy den. This is Bindee's first litter, and keepers say she is doing a wonderful job. Dad, named Jay, is staying his usual calm, relaxed self. The cubs will stay snug in the den for a few months before they come out to explore. Asiatic lions are endangered, so every new cub is a big deal!

news.headline: A Whole Family of World Record Holders
news.body: Everyone in the Rush family from Boise, Idaho, now holds a Guinness World Records title, even 3-year-old Felicity! Her dad, David, has broken more than 400 records over the years. He teamed up with each of his kids for their records. One son helped make a sandwich blindfolded with no hands in 36.5 seconds. Another cleared a game of Hungry Hungry Hippos in just 5.36 seconds! David says he has also failed thousands of times, but he keeps practicing because you can get better at anything.

news.headline: Sky Watchers Find New "Ghosts" in Space
news.body: Just in time for Halloween, a team of sky watchers spotted three faint, glowing clouds hiding in the star pattern called Cassiopeia. They sit near two famous clouds nicknamed the Ghosts of Cassiopeia. The team needed 100 hours of looking through a telescope with a special filter to see them! The new clouds glow blue because they contain a gas called oxygen that has been energized. Nobody knows for sure what made them glow, so scientists are calling it a mystery to solve. Boo!

fun_fact: A lion's roar is so loud it can be heard up to 5 miles away. That's like hearing someone call your name from the next town over! 🦁

joke.q: Why are ghosts such bad liars?
joke.a: Because you can see right through them! 👻

riddle.q: What has a bottom at the top?

word_of_the_day.meaning: to keep trying even when something is hard
word_of_the_day.sentence: The record breaker failed many times, but he chose to persevere until he finally won.

this_day_in_history: On October 23, 2001, Apple introduced the very first iPod, a music player small enough for a pocket that could hold about 1,000 songs! 🎵
did_you_know: Wild Asiatic lions live in just one place on Earth: the Gir Forest area of India. Their numbers have grown a lot thanks to people protecting them. 🌳
